select 
  S.XSAL_0,
  S.XNAMSAL_0,
  S.XPRENOM_0,
  S.XEMAIL_0,
  S.XFLG_0,
  P.YTIT_0,
  Y.TIDCHAT_0,
  Y.YBOT_0,
  Y.LAN_0
  FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS S
  LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS P ON S.ZPOSTE_0 = P.YNUM_0
  LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.YAIINFOSAL AS Y ON S.XSAL_0 = Y.XSAL_0
  where S.XFLG_0 ='2' and P.YTIT_0 IN (
    'RESPONSABLE RESSOURCES HUMAINES',
    'RESPONSABLE RECRUTEMENT',
	'CONSULTANT SAGE X3'
  )

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    S.XSAL_0 AS "Code x3",
    S.XMAT_0 AS "Matricule",
    S.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom",
    S.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom",
    P.YTIT_0 AS "Poste",
    CASE 
        WHEN S.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
        ELSE 'Inactif'
    END AS "Etat",

    S.YSUP_0 AS "Code x3 de Supérieur hiérarchique",
    H.XMAT_0 AS "Matricule SUP",
    H.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom Supérieur hiérarchique",
    H.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom Supérieur hiérarchique",
    CASE 
        WHEN H.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
        ELSE 'Inactif'
    END AS "Etat Supérieur hiérarchique",

    ZPC.YTIT_0 AS "Poste Supérieur hiérarchique correcte",

    STUFF((
        SELECT ', ' + XS.XNAMSAL_0 + ' ' + XS.XPRENOM_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS XS
        INNER JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS XP 
            ON XS.ZPOSTE_0 = XP.YNUM_0
        WHERE XP.YNUM_0 = F.YPOSTRE_0
          AND XS.XFLG_0 = '2'
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') 
    AS "Supérieur hiérarchique correct"

FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS S
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS P 
    ON S.ZPOSTE_0 = P.YNUM_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.YFICHEPOSTE AS F 
    ON F.ZPOSTE_0 = P.YNUM_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS H 
    ON H.XSAL_0 = S.YSUP_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS ZPC
    ON ZPC.YNUM_0 = F.YPOSTRE_0

WHERE 
    S.XFLG_0 = '2'
    AND H.XFLG_0 <> '2';

SELECT 
    S.XSAL_0       AS "Code X3",
    S.XMAT_0       AS "Matricule",
    S.XNAMSAL_0    AS "Nom",
    S.XPRENOM_0    AS "Prénom",
    P.YTIT_0       AS "Poste Employé",
    CASE 
        WHEN S.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
        ELSE 'Inactif'
    END            AS "Etat Employé",
    S.YSUP_0       AS "Code X3 Supérieur",
    H.XMAT_0       AS "Matricule Supérieur",
    H.XNAMSAL_0    AS "Nom Supérieur",
    H.XPRENOM_0    AS "Prénom Supérieur",
    HP.YTIT_0      AS "Poste Supérieur Actuel",
    CASE 
        WHEN H.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
        ELSE 'Inactif'
    END            AS "Etat Supérieur",
    STUFF((
        SELECT ', ' + XS.XNAMSAL_0 + ' ' + XS.XPRENOM_0
        FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL   AS XS
        INNER JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS XP
            ON XS.ZPOSTE_0 = XP.YNUM_0
        WHERE XP.YNUM_0 = F.YPOSTRE_0   
          AND XS.XFLG_0 = '2'
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') 
    AS "Supérieur hiérarchique correct",
    ZPC.YTIT_0     AS "Poste Supérieur correct",
    CASE 
        WHEN HP.YNUM_0 = F.YPOSTRE_0 THEN 'CORRECT'
        ELSE 'INCORRECT'
    END            AS "Statut Supérieur"

FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS S
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS P
    ON S.ZPOSTE_0 = P.YNUM_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.YFICHEPOSTE AS F
    ON F.ZPOSTE_0 = P.YNUM_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS H
    ON H.XSAL_0 = S.YSUP_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS HP
    ON H.ZPOSTE_0 = HP.YNUM_0
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.ZPOSTE AS ZPC
    ON ZPC.YNUM_0 = F.YPOSTRE_0

WHERE 
    S.XFLG_0 = '2'      
    AND H.XFLG_0 = '2'  
    AND HP.YNUM_0 <> F.YPOSTRE_0;

SELECT 
S.XSAL_0 AS "Code x3",
S.XMAT_0 AS "Matricule",
S.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom",
S.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom",
CASE 
     WHEN S.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
     ELSE 'Inactif'
END AS "Etat Salarie",
S.YSUP_0 AS "Code x3 de Supérieur hiérarchique",
H.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom Supérieur hiérarchique",
H.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom Supérieur hiérarchique",
H.XMAT_0 AS "Matricule SUP",
CASE 
     WHEN H.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
     ELSE 'Inactif'
END AS "Etat Supérieur hiérarchique"
FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS S
LEFT JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL AS H
  ON H.XSAL_0 = S.YSUP_0
WHERE S.XFLG_0 = '2'
  AND H.XFLG_0 <> '2';

SELECT 
  S.XSAL_0    AS "Code x3 Salarié",
  S.XMAT_0    AS "Matricule",
  S.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom",
  S.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom",
  CASE 
     WHEN S.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
     ELSE 'Inactif'
  END AS "Etat Salarie",
  H.XSAL_0    AS "Code X3 Supérieur NON actif",
  H.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom Supérieur",
  H.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom Supérieur",
  CASE 
     WHEN H.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
     ELSE 'Inactif'
  END AS "Etat Supérieur",
  H2.XSAL_0   AS "Code X3 Supérieur ACTIF",
  H2.XNAMSAL_0 AS "Nom Supérieur actif",
  H2.XPRENOM_0 AS "Prénom Supérieur actif",
  CASE 
     WHEN H2.XFLG_0 = '2' THEN 'Actif'
     ELSE 'Inactif'
  END AS "Etat Supérieur Actif"
  FROM jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL S
  JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL H
  ON H.XSAL_0 = S.YSUP_0
 AND H.XFLG_0 <> '2'
JOIN jbelrh.JBELRH.XSAL H2
  ON H2.XCIN_0 = H.XCIN_0
 AND H2.XFLG_0 = '2'
 AND H2.XSAL_0 <> H.XSAL_0
WHERE S.XFLG_0 = '2';
